card.line: Migdol, meaning "tower," was a fortified place in northern Egypt, and it is named when Israel camped there and when God spoke about Egypt's future.

moments.title: Camp Near Migdol
moments.text: God told Moses to have the Israelites turn back and camp by the sea, between Migdol and the sea. Pharaoh would think they were boxed in, and God would gain honor over him.

moments.title: A Stop on the Journey
moments.text: Israel set out from Etham, turned back to Pi-hahiroth, and camped near Migdol. From there they crossed through the sea into the wilderness.

moments.title: Jews Living in Egypt
moments.text: God's word came to Jeremiah for the Jews living in Egypt, including those in Migdol. God reminded them that Jerusalem lay in ruins because of the evil of the people.

moments.title: Warning of Babylon's Sword
moments.text: God told Jeremiah to announce in Migdol and other Egyptian cities that Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon was coming against Egypt. Egypt's warriors would fall.

moments.title: From Migdol to Syene
moments.text: God told Ezekiel that Egypt would become a ruin, a desolate wasteland from Migdol to Syene. Egypt's allies would fall by the sword within her.
